_about: Pinned sources of truth for the UCP conformance tester. NEVER test against main/feature branches; pin by the SHAs below. Regenerate intentionally and review the diff. See docs/spec-coverage.md for methodology.
generated_context: Resolved 2026-06-30 via `gh api repos/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/<repo>/commits/<ref>`. Moving-branch pins re-resolved 2026-07-29 (schema_validator), 2026-07-31 (reference_sample_server, official_conformance_suite), 2026-08-03 (reference_sample_server, official_conformance_suite, reference_sdk.pypi_pin) and 2026-08-11 (reference_sample_server; pypi_pin 0.4.4 re-confirmed still latest and the new SHA's pyproject still resolves ucp-sdk from PyPI) the same way. schema_validator drift on 2026-08-03 was a release-please chore only (1.4.1, no engine change) — evaluated and deliberately NOT re-pinned. Release-tag pins (spec versions) are untouched by re-pins.

2026-04-08.note: Tag commit is dated 2026-05-22, NOT 2026-04-08 — release/2026-04-08 received post-date cherry-picks (attribution, identity-linking OAuth rework, selected_options->options, profile-schema fixes). 'What 04-08 contains' = this tagged artifact, not a clean date-cut. release_branch is the live branch the tag was cut from; the sources-age tripwire compares this pinned tag commit against that branch HEAD and WARNS (never re-pins) when the branch advances past the tag, so 'branch moved past the release artifact' stops being invisible.

2026-01-23.release_branch_note: The TAG is the normative release artifact we pin; the release branch is live and can receive post-tag cherry-picks. sources_age --check compares the pinned tag commit to this branch HEAD and warns when it advances (as of 2026-08-11 the branch was ~10 commits ahead) — a review signal, NOT an auto-re-pin.

2026-01-11.release_branch_note: See 2026-01-23.release_branch_note. As of 2026-08-11 release/2026-01-11 was ~4 commits ahead of the pinned tag — surfaced by the sources-age tripwire, reviewed, not auto-re-pinned.

official_conformance_suite.note: SIGNAL, NOT ORACLE. RE-PINNED 2026-08-03 from f252c0d7 (2026-07-31): one upstream commit, conformance#72 (fulfillment_test.py asserts the configured base price instead of a hardcoded one) — a test-soundness fix, no new assertions. Prior re-pin history: RE-PINNED 2026-07-31 from 948e7d22 (2026-06-23, ~38d stale per the sources-age tripwire). The old note said this suite hard-asserts spec version 2026-01-23 — that is NO LONGER TRUE at this SHA: protocol_test now validates the discovery version structurally (date-shaped) and takes the exact-version assertion from conformance_input.json ('ucp_version', default in integration_test_utils), so the suite tests whichever release the merchant targets. That change is our merged conformance#58. This SHA also contains our merged #62 (discount), #64 (totals) and #68 (fulfillment_structure_test.py), plus upstream #67/#69/#70/#71. No release tags exist; pinned to a main SHA which can drift — the sources-age gate is what surfaces that drift.

schema_validator.note: Rust CLI (`cargo install ucp-schema`). Used as the schema-validation ORACLE. No release tags; pinned to main SHA. Does NOT cover prose-only invariants (totals sums, lookup dedup, line-item retention) — those are separate coded checks. RE-PINNED 2026-07-29 from 115ae836 (2026-06-30): picks up ucp-schema #37 (namespace authority binding now enforced on services and payment_handlers, not just capabilities — ucp#530) and #41 (accept exact authority match, e.g. a handler com.example.pay served from pay.example.com). Both engine changes verified NON-REGRESSING against our conformant fixtures: the full selftest stayed 52/52 green under the new binary, and the new engine's own 68 unit/integration/doc tests pass (incl. verify_bindings_rejects_unbound_service/_payment_handler + accepts_exact_authority_match). Strictly more faithful; #41 is only more permissive, so it cannot introduce a false-reject.

reference_sample_server.note: Flower Shop reference merchant (samples/rest/python/server) — the KNOWN-COMPLIANT target for self-validation. RE-PINNED 2026-08-11 from a95b928b (2026-08-03). Seven commits, verified == upstream main HEAD at re-pin time. Python golden behavior: #166 (idempotency hashes scoped to operation+resource_id — cross-operation key reuse now 409s instead of replaying a cached foreign response; our probes always mint fresh keys per op, verified no verdict flip), #167 (checkout id assigned server side, client-sent id ignored — our probes read the id from the CREATE RESPONSE, never assume the request id round-trips), #161 (upstream's own integration test derives the unsupported version dynamically — test-only, no server behavior change). Node reference behavior: #162 (RFC 9421 request signature verification middleware — enforced only when REQUIRE_SIGNATURES=true, verify-and-log otherwise, so unsigned probes still pass), #168 (fixes BOTH prior Node deviations: DISC-003 discovery Cache-Control + PAY-003 ucp.payment_handlers in the checkout envelope — the two matching differential_allowlist entries expired with this pin and were removed; the CHK-050/053 flat-`detail` error-shape entries remain, re-verified still deviating on the wire at this SHA). #164/#165 are dep bumps (hono, cryptography), no wire effect. A no-op test still passes against this server, which is why every check also needs a negative fixture (mutation proxy). Run on port 8182; sim endpoints gated by --simulation_secret.
reference_sample_server.sdk_resolution: This SHA DROPPED the server pyproject's [tool.uv.sources] ucp-sdk = { path = '../../../../python-sdk/', editable = true }. The server therefore resolves ucp-sdk from PyPI, NOT from our SHA-pinned vendored python-sdk. Left unmanaged that turns a pinned golden into a floating one, defeating the purpose of this lock, so the resolved PyPI version is recorded in reference_sdk.pypi_pin and asserted at boot.

reference_sdk.pypi_pin_note: BUMPED 2026-08-03 from 0.4.3: PyPI 0.4.4 (uploaded 09:16Z, release v2026-04-08-4) is the release cut for our merged python-sdk#57 (contains/minContains/maxContains validators enforced on generated models). The golden survives these stricter validators because samples#152 (valid seeded totals) was built for exactly that combination — the #57/#152 coordination proved 69/0 with validators active. serve_golden.sh asserts this exact version at boot.
reference_sdk.note: HOW THE GOLDEN GETS ITS SDK CHANGED AT THE 2026-07-31 RE-PIN. Before: the 2026-01-23 Flower Shop server took ucp-sdk as an editable path dep, so this vendored SHA (f54858e, the last 2026-01-23-compatible SDK, 0.3.0 — the commit immediately before python-sdk main's 'upgrade SDK to UCP v2026-04-08', which ImportErrors on Checkout from ap2_mandate) WAS the SDK under test. After: the re-pinned server has no [tool.uv.sources], so it installs ucp-sdk from PyPI and this vendored clone is no longer what the golden runs. The clone is still materialized (cheap, and it keeps the 01-23 trio reproducible), but the version that actually matters for a reproducible verdict is pypi_pin above — the resolved PyPI release the golden runs on. serve_golden.sh asserts the installed version equals pypi_pin and fails loudly on drift, so a silent PyPI bump can never change a verdict unnoticed. Bump pypi_pin deliberately, the same way a SHA is re-pinned. The underlying rule is unchanged: pin compatible trios (conformance/samples/SDK), not bare main.

ap2_reference.note: The pinned AP2 reference implementation — the interop ORACLE for the moving AP2 mandate delegate-chain layer (testbed/provenance.py REFERENCE_SHA, testbed/gen_goldens.py). It is a FIXTURE, never a graded subject; the testbed pip-installs it at this exact SHA (`pip install git+https://github.com/google-agentic-commerce/AP2@e1ea56d`). SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the AP2 pin: testbed/provenance.py.REFERENCE_SHA must equal this commit, and the P1-9 self-expiring known_ap2_reference_defects register keys its re-pin trigger to it (a filed AP2 defect entry EXPIRES the moment a re-pin makes the reference produce the correct outcome). Before this lock entry the AP2 pin lived ONLY in provenance.py prose, so an AP2 upstream release was detected by NOBODY — this closes that blind spot: pinned to ref `main`, the sources-age tripwire (sources_age.py --check) now compares this commit to AP2 upstream HEAD and warns on drift, which is exactly the re-pin trigger the P1-9 guard needs to become real. Verified 2026-04-29 e1ea56d == AP2 main HEAD at 2026-08-11 (upstream quiet since v0.2, 2026-04-29). Re-pin deliberately, the same discipline as every other pin; when re-pinned, re-verify provenance.REFERENCE_SHA and let the self-expiring defect entries reconcile.
